kinds.a: window squeegee · glass wiper · shower squeegee
kinds.d: Rubber-bladed tool drawn across glass or tiles to remove water.
Handheld battery device with a squeegee blade that sucks water off windows and tiles.
Self-driving device that holds itself to a window by suction and cleans the glass.

notes: Three kinds kept as planned, none merged or dropped. Squeegee: variants (hand, combination washer, telescopic pole kit, shower) moved to types; Unger and OXO added as market-covering brands per shelf brief (model names ErgoTec / Good Grips to verify). Window vacuum: dropped superseded WV 2 (WV 2 Plus kept); added Vileda Windomatic and Bosch GlassVAC per brief; Kärcher WV remains the reference range. Window-cleaning robot: Ecovacs WINBOT SKU list cut from 10 to 3 (W1 PRO, W2 PRO OMNI, mini 2 — the base, flagship and compact lines; W2 PRO, W2S, W2S OMNI, W2S PRO, W2S PRO OMNI, W3 OMNI, mini dropped as SKU-level variants of the same families); Kärcher RCW 2/4 kept; Hobot added per brief (HOBOT-2S model number to verify). Spelling normalised to Kärcher. All old source URLs retained; no new kinds, archetypes or brand entries.
